short.text: Justin Blackmon served a four-game league suspension in 2013 and was active for {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games for Jacksonville, carrying the Z workload later in the season, before Jacksonville traded him to Indianapolis with Cecil Shorts in March 2014. He was a physical outside receiver with strong hands, power at the catch point and run-after-catch ability, and he stressed coverage when he was aligned correctly. His alignment and his adjustments to coverage were not consistent enough for him to use those tools on every snap.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
Moved to reserve/suspended for a four-game league suspension
Reinstated from the suspension and activated
Traded by Jacksonville to Indianapolis, with Cecil Shorts, for 2014 picks No. 82 and No. 194
